title: Mack's mother sends him to Bud Hopkins

tellings.quote: And so that's how it happened is he ended up talking to Bud Hopkins

plain: The Harvard psychiatrist John Mack, who became known for studying people who said they had been abducted by aliens, got into the subject because his mother sent him to talk to Budd Hopkins, an artist who researched abduction accounts. The lawyer Dan Sheehan, who knew Mack, passes on this account of how Mack's work began. He tells it to explain how a respected academic came to take the subject seriously.
